name: Beached Sea Creature
summary: Along Darkshore, a giant sea mammal lies washed ashore beside an abandoned dig site. Its carcass and scattered tools draw murlocs and passing travelers.

sections.title: A Halted Excavation
sections.body: A giant sea mammal lies on Darkshore's sand, partly gutted and worn by the sea. A rusted wheelbarrow and discarded tools mark the place where an organized study began. The researchers left before they could finish.

sections.title: The League and the Murlocs
sections.body: Dwarven field researchers from the Explorer's League were studying the carcass in Darkshore. Their work stopped when local murlocs swarmed the site to scavenge. Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine acts for the Temple of the Moon and accepts salvaged bone samples to help study the unnatural wash-ups along the coast.

faq.q: What is this creature lying on the beach?
faq.answer: It is the remains of a giant sea mammal washed ashore on Darkshore. No one has identified its species, but its size has drawn scavenging murlocs and dwarven researchers.

faq.q: Who left the tools and wheelbarrow behind?
faq.answer: Dwarven members of the Explorer's League left the tools. They began an excavation to study the beached creature, but hostile coastal murlocs drove them away before they could finish.

faq.q: Why does Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde want these bones?
aliases: temple of the moon sea creature
faq.answer: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde collects samples for the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. The night elves are investigating the strange deaths of massive sea creatures washing ashore along Darkshore.

faq.q: Why are murlocs prowling around the carcass?
faq.answer: Murlocs came to scavenge the carcass for meat and blubber. They chased off the dwarven scholars and now defend the remains for themselves.

faq.q: Is the Explorer's League officially allied with Auberdine here?
faq.answer: Yes. The Explorer's League is part of the Alliance and has a presence in Darkshore. It works with local night elf authorities and shares reports of its discoveries and coastal investigations.

faq.q: Are there other beached creatures along the Darkshore coast?
faq.answer: Yes. Enormous marine beasts and skeletal remains have washed ashore along Darkshore's beaches, pointing to widespread disturbance in the waters off Kalimdor.

angles.text: The abandoned tools belong to your kin in the Explorer's League. Native murlocs chased them from their dig site.
The Temple of the Moon is deeply concerned by the unnatural number of massive sea creatures dying and washing ashore on Darkshore's sacred coast.
This discovery shows Darnassus and the Ironforge Explorer's League working together to record Kalimdor's mysteries.
